biodb-desc: Retrieve information from an existing Biological Database
apihelp-biodb-param-query: Query name to retrieve, as defined in $wgBioDBExpose configuration
apihelp-biodb-param-param: Parameter(s) to pass to the query
apihelp-biodb-param-fileformat: In table output, download as this file format (e.g. csv)
apihelp-biodb-param-sep: Column separator when using csv fileformat (default: tab)
apihelp-biodb-param-typesolve: Automatically cast numeric values to int or float
